decision.reasoning_trace: I chose the TECWARE Phantom 87 Key Mechanical Keyboard as the final choice because it has the highest rating (4.6) and a large number of reviews (5974), indicating a high level of customer satisfaction. Additionally, it is a complete mechanical keyboard with RGB LED and Outemu Brown Switch, making it a great option for those looking for a high-quality mechanical keyboard. The other products in the consideration set are also high-quality mechanical keyboards, but they may have some drawbacks, such as higher prices or fewer reviews.
